from pathlib import Path
fd = os.open('/data/z.zip', os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT)

    z.writestr('inner.txt', 'zipped')
try:
    os.close(fd)
except OSError as e:
    print(errno.errorcode[e.errno])

    print(z.read('inner.txt').decode(), os.path.exists('/data/z.zip'))
fd = os.open('/data/raw.bin', os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT)
f = os.fdopen(fd, 'wb', 0)
f.write(b'raw')
os.fsync(fd)
print(f.fileno() == fd, open('/data/raw.bin', 'rb').read())
f.close()
with open('/data/lines.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('alpha\nbeta\n')
with open('/data/lines.txt') as f:
    print(repr(f.readline(3)), f.readlines(1))
with open('/data/lines.txt', 'rb') as f:
    print(repr(io.TextIOWrapper(f, encoding='utf-8').read()))
Path('/data/touched').touch()
fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(dir='/data')
os.write(fd, b'stemp')
os.close(fd)
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir='/data', delete=False) as f:
    f.write(b'named')
print(Path('/data/touched').exists(), Path(name).read_text(), Path(f.name).read_text())
